name: EPIC Day Camp at Germantown Friends School
description_short: Five week themed day camp at Germantown Friends School's main campus for children 3 to 9, rising preschool through grade 3. Campers have specials in music, dance, STEM, art and outdoor adventure, library visits, and water play or swimming at Germantown Cricket Club for the older groups.

fees.name: Center City shuttle (601 Walnut Street, through July 17)

refund_policy_summary: Full refund within 48 hours of registering; after that a $100 cancellation fee per session; no refunds on or after May 4, 2026.

notes: 2026: June 15 to July 17, 8:30 am to 3:30 pm, closed June 19 and July 3 (those weeks prorated). Early Childhood weeks $450 ($360 short weeks); Lower School weeks $475 ($380 short weeks); price_per_week is the Lower School rate. 25% deposit until March 15. 10% off 3 or more weeks booked by March 15. Campers must be 3 and potty trained. Preschool to K groups do not swim at GCC and have an afternoon rest. GFS also runs sports and one week specialty camps on the same campus through July 31. Non tuition financial aid is only for current or incoming GFS students. 2027 details not posted yet.
